title: Associative ambiguous dictionary-identity negative control
mode: Generated local ASCII/Binary DXF fast slice
scope: Exercise ambiguous dictionary callback identity without malformed duplicate-handle DXF input.
Require the ambiguous owner identity not to root or qualify the associative record.
Verify the bounded scan completes and the following DICTIONARYVAR remains observable.

control.probe: AmbiguousDictionaryProbe calls dx_iface::addDictionary twice for the same generated source handle.
expected: captureComplete, handleCodeScanComplete, and ownerChainScanComplete are true
one associative source record is retained
both dictionary callbacks remain visible to the test adapter
the following DICTIONARYVAR sentinel is delivered
control.claimCeiling: Adapter-level ambiguous dictionary identity fails to root the owner chain; this is not malformed-input policy, associative class grammar, edge-role closure, or replay qualification.

method.commitLimitation: .git is read-only in the active workspace and the checkout already contains broad overlapping user changes; no staging or commit was attempted.
method.limitations: The callback-duplication test validates the adapter owner inventory's ambiguous-key behavior, not the parser's acceptance of duplicate handles in a real DXF file, undocumented associative edge roles, same-profile output replay, or independent/native semantics. Generated scratch files are removed by the test.
